HELLOSPIRE-HELLO_SPIRE.title: The Greeter
HELLOSPIRE-HELLO_SPIRE.description: A wanderer who arrived at the Spire with nothing but a borrowed blade and an open hand. Starts with the Ironclad's kit while their own story is still being written.
HELLOSPIRE-HELLO_SPIRE.goldMonologue: Coins are just introductions that jingle.
HELLOSPIRE-HELLO_SPIRE.eventDeathPrevent: The Greeter waves once more, and the dark politely waits.
HELLOSPIRE-HELLO_SPIRE.aromaPrinciple: Smells like a doorway held open too long.
HELLOSPIRE-HELLO_SPIRE.cardsModifierDesc: The Greeter's deck is still borrowed. For now.
